title: ORBIT-2: Scaling Exascale Vision Foundation Models for Weather and Climate Downscaling
problem: Sparse observations and coarse-resolution climate models limit regional decision-making; existing AI methods struggle with generalization across variables/geographies and face quadratic complexity in Vision Transformer self-attention, preventing long-sequence processing at scale.
motivation: Climate downscaling to high resolution (0.9 km globally) requires massive parallelism and efficient architectures. Foundation models must generalize across diverse geographies and variables while handling billion-token sequences on exascale systems.
method: ORBIT-2 combines two techniques to efficiently process long climate sequences at scale. First, it uses Reslim, a lightweight neural network (based on Vision Transformers) with skip connections (residual learning—adding the input directly to the output to improve training) and Bayesian regularization (which quantifies uncertainty to prevent overfitting). Second, it uses the TILES algorithm to speed up attention (the mechanism that finds relationships between all data points): instead of checking every possible relationship in quadratic time, it processes data in tiles, reducing cost to linear time; this scales to 10 billion parameters across 65,536 GPUs.
key_novelty: ORBIT-2 reduces transformer attention complexity from quadratic to linear using the TILES algorithm, enabling billion-token climate sequences with Reslim's efficient residual architecture and Bayesian uncertainty estimates, achieving 74-98% scaling efficiency at 10 billion parameters on 65,536 exascale GPUs.
contributions: TILES algorithm reducing Vision Transformer self-attention complexity from quadratic to linear
Residual Slim ViT combining residual learning with Bayesian regularization for efficient robust prediction
Exascale deployment achieving 4.1 ExaFLOPS sustained throughput across 65,536 GPUs
Global hyper-resolution climate downscaling to 0.9 km with R² 0.98-0.99 on 7 km benchmarks
Demonstrated handling of 4.2 billion token sequences in inference
baselines: Standard Vision Transformer with quadratic attention
limitations: Limited details on inference latency and deployment scenarios
Abstract-only prevents evaluation of Reslim Bayesian uncertainty calibration
primary_theme: Efficient exascale foundation models via linear-attention algorithms
